rationale: A correct y axis label written the way d3/matplotlib export it: transform="rotate(-90)" with x=-150 y=22 (the coordinates are in the rotated frame). The bbox code only handles rotate(a cx cy) and treats x=-150 as a canvas coordinate, reporting a 157 px overflow of the left edge. Rule change: when rotate() has no centre, map (x, y) through the rotation before building the bbox.
